text: {"hypotheses":[{"statement":"Beverage revenue is high primarily because a small number of top products dominate sales, not because beverage sales are broadly strong across the menu","priorConfidence":0.55,"target":"beverage_revenue_by_product","action":"breakdown","expectation":"A small subset of product_name values (e.g. top 2-3) account for a disproportionate share (>60%) of total beverage revenue"},{"statement":"Beverage revenue is high because one customer_type (e.g. corporate or loyalty members) purchases far more drinks than others, not due to uniform demand across segments","priorConfidence":0.5,"target":"customer_profile","action":"breakdown","expectation":"drink revenue or order_item.drink_revenue_pct is markedly higher for one customer_type than the others when broken down by customer_type"},{"statement":"Beverage revenue is high mainly due to a small set of top individual customers driving outsized volume, rather than broad-based customer demand","priorConfidence":0.4,"target":"top_beverage_customers","action":"lookup_block","expectation":"The top customers by customer_name in this block represent a large, concentrated share of total beverage revenue rather than an even distribution"},{"statement":"Beverage revenue is high because it has been growing rapidly month-over-month, indicating a recent trend rather than a stable historical pattern","priorConfidence":0.45,"target":"order_item.revenue_growth_mom","action":"compare_time","expectation":"order_item.revenue_growth_mom for drink revenue shows consistent positive growth across recent months rather than flat or declining trend"},{"statement":"Beverage revenue is high mainly because of higher order frequency (more drink orders), not because each order carries a higher drink price/value","priorConfidence":0.4,"target":"orders.drink_orders","action":"compare_time","expectation":"orders.drink_orders volume trend closely tracks total drink revenue growth, while order_item.drink_revenue_pct per order stays roughly flat over time"},{"statement":"Beverage revenue's share of total revenue is high because food revenue is comparatively weak, making drinks look disproportionately large rather than beverages themselves growing","priorConfidence":0.35,"target":"order_item.food_revenue_pct","action":"compare_time","expectation":"order_item.food_revenue_pct is declining or flat over time while order_item.drink_revenue_pct rises, indicating a shift in mix rather than absolute beverage growth"}]}
